chunks: He said: Abul Qasim Ismail ibn Muhammad al-Anbari al-Katib narrated to us, he said: Abu Abdillah Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Azdi narrated to us, he said: Shu'ayb ibn Ayyub narrated to us, he said: Mu'awiyah ibn Hisham narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Hisham ibn Hassan, who said: I heard Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, addressing the people after the pledge of allegiance to him with the authority.

He said: "We are the victorious party of God, the nearest kinfolk of His Messenger, the pure and immaculate members of his household. We are one of the Two Weighty Things which the Messenger of God, may God's blessings be upon him and his family, left behind in his nation. The other is the Book of God, in which is the expounding of all things — no falsehood comes to it from before it or from behind it. The reliance is upon us for its interpretation; we do not resort to conjecture in its explanation, but rather we are certain of its realities.
So obey us, for our obedience is obligatory, since it is coupled with obedience to God, Mighty and Majestic, and His Messenger.

God, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'O you who believe, obey God and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you. If you dispute about anything, refer it to God and the Messenger.' And: 'If they had referred it to the Messenger and to those in authority among them, those capable of deducing would have known it.'
And I warn you against listening to the yelling of Satan among you, for he is a manifest enemy to you. Otherwise you would be like his allies to whom he said:

'No one can overcome you today among the people, and I am your protector.' But when the two groups confronted each other, he turned on his heels and said: 'I am free of you, I see what you do not see.'
Then you will fall prey to the lances as a burden, to the swords as slaughter, to the maces shattered, and to the arrows as targets.
Then: 'It shall not profit a soul to believe that had not believed before, or earned goodness in its faith.'

key_terms.أولي الأمر: Those in authority — a Quranic term (4:59) which Shia exegesis identifies as the Imams from Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.البيعة: The pledge of allegiance — the formal oath of loyalty given to a new caliph
key_terms.الثقلين: The Two Weighty Things — referring to the Quran and the Prophet's family, from the famous hadith al-Thaqalayn
key_terms.حزب الله: Party of God — a Quranic title (5:56) for the faithful allies of God
key_terms.عترة: Progeny/kinfolk — specifically the Prophet's household (Ahl al-Bayt), one of the Two Weighty Things

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Hasan say in his first sermon after becoming caliph?
ai.summary: This is the inaugural sermon of Imam Hasan ibn Ali (AS) after the people of Kufa pledged their allegiance to him as caliph following the assassination of Imam Ali (AS) in 40 AH. In it, he asserts the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt as one of the Two Weighty Things (al-Thaqalayn) left by the Prophet, establishes their exclusive right to interpret the Quran, commands obedience as a divine obligation, and warns against following Satan's deception — citing the Battle of Badr narrative from Surah al-Anfal as a cautionary example.
